name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Bomb Pop
description: Bomb Pop TRIPLE-Stacked BITEZ took over and never left. Three vibrant layers of sweet cherry, zesty lime, and tangy Blue Razz stack together for that unmistakable red, white, and blue frozen-treat flavor with a BITEZ twist. Each triple-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). Nostalgia never hit this hard.
